title: Certifications Check
description: Predict how a certification attempt outcome maps to what shows up on a profile.

questions.prompt: How is a HackerRank Skill Certification attempt graded?

options.text: As a percentage score shown publicly on the profile
As a binary pass/fail outcome for the whole attempt
By peer review after submission
By the number of certifications already earned

questions.explanation: A certification attempt has one outcome: pass or fail as a whole, based on a minimum threshold.

questions.prompt: What does the public profile show after a failed certification attempt?

options.text: A partial-credit badge
Nothing new — only passed attempts become visible badges
A red "failed" badge
The exact score obtained

questions.explanation: Failed attempts aren't displayed publicly; only a passed attempt produces a certificate badge.

questions.prompt: Why is a certification considered a stronger signal than a self-reported skill?

options.text: It's timed and proctored, making it harder to fake
It contributes directly to the Problem-Solving Score
It's automatically renewed every year
It replaces the need for practice challenges

questions.explanation: The timed, proctored conditions make a passed certification a verified claim rather than a self-reported one.

questions.prompt: A candidate re-attempts a certification after failing once, and passes the second time. What shows on the profile?

options.text: Two badges, one marked failed and one passed
One badge, from the passed attempt
No badge, because one attempt failed
A badge only after a third attempt

questions.explanation: Only the passed outcome produces a badge; the earlier failed attempt leaves no public trace.

questions.prompt: Does passing a JavaScript certification change a profile's SQL score?

options.text: Yes, certifications add points to every related domain score
No, certifications and domain practice scores are independent
Only if the SQL score is already above intermediate
Yes, but only for Advanced-level certifications

questions.explanation: Certifications are a separate signal from domain practice scores — passing one doesn't move the other.
